description: Three-page French annual operating report of a fictitious district heating network, typeset with Typst 0.15: a two-column summary (columns balanced with a column break), a table with booktabs-style rules, a display formula and an inline formula with a minus sign, a bar chart drawn with Typst rectangles, « » quotes with no-break spaces, narrow no-break spaces before % and in thousands, small caps and two footnotes. Edits: the unit of the pump electricity consumption, a new table row, the sign of the 2025 budget variance, the value in the inline formula, the December bar of the chart, a sentence deleted, a quoted audit finding, and a paragraph moved from the two-column summary on page 1 to the Perspectives section on page 3. Consequences only: the left summary column becomes shorter, the table grows by one row, the text on pages 1 to 3 shifts and re-flows, and the Perspectives section on page 3 grows; the chart stays at the top of page 2. Producer: Typst 0.15.0 (Python package typst 0.15.0), Libertinus Serif and New Computer Modern Math embedded by Typst. Synthetic sample: all parties, places and figures are fictitious.

truth.note: Only the unit changes (GWh -> MWh); in the right column of the two-column summary. Two-column layout: the README lists multi-column reading-order reconstruction only on its roadmap (Typst writes the left column before the right one in the content stream).
2025 budget variance loses its minus sign (−4,2 % -> 4,2 %); the 2024 cell (−1,2 %) is unchanged context. Narrow no-break spaces before %.
Inline Typst math (New Computer Modern Math): ΔT = −0,8 K -> −1,3 K; each math glyph is a separate text item, minus is U+2212. Typst math formulas are not mentioned in the README.
Bar for 'déc.' in Fig. 1 is taller (6.4 -> 7.9 GWh); no data labels, the axis labels are unchanged. Rect covers the December bar position up to the top grid line.
